series_break: ESI-1 -> ESI-2 is an explicit source-inventory measurement-series break. CMS-1 remains unchanged.

authority.statement: ESI-2 is the native deterministic source/symbol and static-reference inventory used by --inventory. It does not grant MusicMutation, Writer, Repair, Selection or Release authority.

source_scope.scope_hash: SHA-256 over slash-normalized relative path + NUL + per-file SHA-256, ordered lexicographically

symbol_contract.test_scope: Item attributes are parsed structurally from tokens. A cfg(test)-bound module/trait/impl/function propagates Test only into its syntactic descendants; attributes from a preceding sibling cannot leak into the next item.
symbol_contract.sensitive_declaration: cfg/cfg_attr/test/bench/dead_code/export/no_mangle/link_section/used/proc-macro evidence blocks a deletion proof where applicable.

fingerprints.signature_fingerprint: SHA-256 over normalized declaration tokens including literal-content hashes and excluding whitespace/comments
fingerprints.body_fingerprint: SHA-256 over normalized body tokens including literal-content hashes and excluding whitespace/comments; declaration-only methods use none

reference_contract.lexical_hits: Diagnostic simple-name occurrences only; never interpreted as uniquely resolved references.
reference_contract.resolved_references: Reference sites resolved to exactly one symbol by unique global identity, explicit qualified suffix or same-module free-function resolution.
reference_contract.ambiguous_references: Reference sites for which the target cannot be proven uniquely. Ambiguity remains explicit and blocks removal proof.
reference_contract.value_bindings: Resolved function-value/callback bindings such as map/map_or arguments, assignment and collection/return positions; these edges propagate reachability.
reference_contract.method_receiver_rule: A dot-member call is never resolved merely because its simple method name is globally unique; without receiver proof it remains ambiguous.

root_model.public_api_roots: unrestricted pub functions in the directly exported lib.rs module surface that ESI-2 can prove
root_model.restricted_visibility: pub(crate), pub(super) and pub(in ...) are not automatic productive roots
root_model.uncertain_pub: unrestricted pub outside a proven exported API surface is retained as uncertain reachability, not silently promoted to a productive root

run_binding.project: PROJECT with exact project and current observation run_id
run_binding.corpus: CORPUS with current completed full-corpus manifest plus the current observation run_id used by all ten CMS-1 snapshots; corpus_manifest_run_id and observation run_id are distinct authorities and are both retained
run_binding.input_fingerprint: scope-specific SHA-256 projection of current project input fingerprints

projection.json: EtuSchlopf.inventory.json schema_version=2 is the machine-readable native record
projection.xlsx: EtuSchlopf.inventory.xlsx is XLSX-2 projection of the same model
projection.assistant_export: both files are included iff --inventory produced them
projection.stale_current_artifacts: normal runs without --inventory remove current root inventory artifacts; assistant exports remain historical evidence

comparability.rule: ESI source-inventory and reference/reachability counts are directly comparable only when inventory_contract_version is identical. ESI-1 and ESI-2 are intentionally not one direct measurement series.
